name: YouTube Audio
description: Search YouTube and play just the sound from the terminal, with a queue. Plays inside PythonOS: nothing to install on the computer.

changelog.1.0.0: First release: search, play a link or a playlist, queue, with mpv, VLC or ffplay.
changelog.1.1.0: The yt-dlp library is now installed by the marketplace into the app's own folder (marketplace API 2), so nothing is asked the first time you run it.
changelog.1.2.0: Plays the sound itself (av and miniaudio libraries, installed by the marketplace), so no mpv, VLC or ffplay is needed; they are only a fallback.
